finding: This file contains sanitized, reusable thumbnail observations rather than private campaign history.
A focal object or action should identify the video's real subject without relying on the title.
One dominant subject with one supporting cue is easier to parse at thumbnail size than several equal-weight elements.
Inspect every candidate at approximately 168 to 220 pixels wide as well as full resolution.
Add words, logos, and interface details in post when a generator cannot reproduce them accurately; use only assets authorized for the project.
Numbers, revenue, view counts, quotes, and product results should be sourced or clearly labeled as illustrative.
Use a person's likeness only with permission, and keep face references, provider IDs, signed URLs, and account details out of shared templates.
Persona simulations and automated thumbnail scores are advisory comparisons, not measurements or predictions of real CTR.
When practical, change one major variable per variant so later analytics can produce interpretable learning.
Review faces, hands, lettering, logos, UI, edges, and crop zones at full size before publishing.
